#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

class TaskG {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        int v[10] = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = in.nextInt();
            v[x] = 1;
        }
        vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if (p % 2 != 0) {
                ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, MOD);
            }
            p /= 2;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyMod(v, v, MOD);
        }
        int res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (res + (long)x * x) % MOD;
        }
        out << res << endl;
    }

    vector<int> multiplyMod(vector<int> a, vector<int> b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = max(2, (int)(ceil(log2(need - 1 + 1)) + 1));

        vector<double> aReal(n);
        vector<double> aImaginary(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            aImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(aReal, aImaginary, false);

        vector<double> bReal(n);
        vector<double> bImaginary(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
            int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            bImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(bReal, bImaginary, false);

        vector<double> faReal(n);
        vector<double> faImaginary(n);
        vector<double> fbReal(n);
        vector<double> fbImaginary(n);

        double cf = 0.25 / n;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

            double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
            double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

            double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
            double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

            faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

            fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }

        fft(faReal, faImaginary, true);
        fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, true);
        vector<int> res(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long aa = (long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
            long bb = (long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
            long cc = (long)(faImaginary[i] + 0.5);
            res[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % MOD) << 15) + ((cc % MOD) << 30)) % MOD);
        }
        return res;
    }

    void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
        int n = a.size();
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_revdi2(i << shift);
            if (i < j) {
                double temp = a[i];
                a[i] = a[j];
                a[j] = temp;
                temp = b[i];
                b[i] = b[j];
                b[j] = temp;
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int halfLen = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cs(halfLen);
            vector<double> sn(halfLen);
            for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
                cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1));
                sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                    double wA = cs[j];
                    double wB = sn[j];
                    double uA = a[i + j];
                    double uB = b[i + j];
                    double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                    double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                    a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                    a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                    b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] /= n;
                b[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader(istream& is) : is(is) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = is.get();
        while (isWhitespace(c))
            c = is.get();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = is.get();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("Invalid input");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = is.get();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

    bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t';
    }

private:
    istream& is;
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    TaskG solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
